conditions.requirement: Preserve the complete title/copy; do not invent additional copy, logos, sponsors or labels.

evidence.observation: Title/copy and absence of added sponsors/labels are checked independently of scene quality.

conditions.requirement: A substantive content-grounded non-glyph visual is required; glyph-only output, 3D type alone, texture and token ornament are insufficient.

evidence.observation: A substantial nonglyph clay body is actually visible; scene/action weaknesses are recorded separately.

content_form.location: central purple dome and side folds between open hands
content_form.observation: A single purple mass connects broad base, stacked side pressure folds and a rising rounded dome. The curved hands are offset from the folded sides, supplying a release cue directly tied to the same clay.

content_form.location: middle scene between title and event label
content_form.observation: The hands and large dome remain identifiable, and the pressure-fold-to-rounded-center relationship survives reduction.

hierarchy.location: title, hands/clay scene and lower centered information
hierarchy.observation: The full-width top title leads into the central material scene; the event label and remaining centered copy form a clear supporting stack.
Title, purple dome and event label form a stable three-part reading route; logistics and registration remain subordinate.

typography.location: purple title and lower information stack
typography.observation: Rounded raised Hangul has clear counters and readable word separation. All six supplied entries are retained, including the date/time and protected URL on single lines.
The supporting copy remains readable with consistent relief and color; the URL has adequate horizontal extent and no inserted slash spaces.

space.location: hands entering side crops around central dome
space.observation: The mirrored side hands balance the dome and preserve a clear gap above the centered event label. The full-width title and lower stack align with the scene's central axis.
Consistent vertical spacing separates event label, subtitle, date/time, venue and registration without creating a disconnected empty area.

image_material.location: purple side compression folds, dome and peach hands
image_material.observation: Clay grain, dents, soft edges and grounding shadows are consistent across hands and mass. The wrinkled sides remain continuous with the smoother raised center and pooled base.
Strong purple-yellow complement keeps the complete deformation legible; the peach hands remain a distinct interacting material element.

emotion_control.location: yellow field, purple title and central hands
emotion_control.observation: The sunny palette and oversized soft forms communicate an inviting hands-on youth maker event.
The direct touch/release gesture adds a friendly human invitation while the centered stack controls the playful exaggeration.

ai_slop.observation: The fingers, folded sides and central dome are organized into one coherent interaction. No invented badges, sponsors, labels or extraneous ornaments appear.
The consistent material and repeated purple type serve a clear arrangement rather than a scatter of generic motifs.

residuals: The original recovered shape is not as specifically described as M3's nearly rounded terminal bulge, but the released hands and rising dome communicate the requested moment.
The centered title/scene/information organization is familiar; its specificity comes chiefly from the deformation and hand relationship.

evidence.observation: A vertical platen/lump on the right balances a left text column. Unlike M3's horizontal roller transition and M5's centered hands, pressure is staged vertically; it shares the folded-dome family with M5.

evidence.location: lower clover and upper text band
evidence.observation: A four-lobed yellow mass in opposing curved tools creates a lateral squeeze configuration, with a full-width title and split supporting blocks. This changes topology, tool relation and layout, not just palette.

evidence.location: central horizontal transformation and bottom title
evidence.observation: A roller produces a flattened-to-rounded continuous red progression across the page, paired with a bottom title; this is the clearest distinct temporal/material concept in the set.

evidence.location: blue crescent enclosing title and right-column information
evidence.observation: The giant open curved body encloses a title pocket under a tilted stamp, creating a distinct figure/ground and reading arrangement. Its recovery problem does not erase its compositional difference.

evidence.location: hands around dome and centered information stack
evidence.observation: Human hands replace mechanical tooling around a centered purple rebound dome, with information below. It shares M1's pooled-base/folded-lump vocabulary but changes gesture, balance and reading route.

residuals: The five members offer meaningful differences in topology, tool/hand interaction and reading route, but share thick rounded clay type, one dominant mass, uniform saturated fields and coarse material grain.
M1 and M5 are related folded-dome concepts, and M2/M5 share a top-title/central-scene organization. Diversity is strong rather than exceptionally broad.
M2 and M4's weaker recovery communication is preserved in their individual evaluations; diversity does not cancel those failures.
